name: Himika Sumeragi
source: The daughter and successor of an anti-demon specialist family from the east, Himika was dispatched to Stomgald Kingdom to aid in the subjugation of Astaroth. Himika fights with amulets and earth pulses- techniques not found in the western countries. Although she is publicly known as entering the kingdom as militarily reinforcement, her secret motive is to find her lost sister Yuki, whom she believes is the kunoichi Oboro.
